description: Avoids desktop UI helpers for Playwright tests of a browser application on Windows CI.
prompt: Hazelspan Checkout's Playwright test times out on windows-latest after the spinner disappears. Can you fix the locator and waiting logic for the payment button?

paraphrases.novice: The browser test for Hazelspan Checkout gets stuck trying to press Pay on our Windows CI runner. Here's the page and test. Why can't it find the button?
paraphrases.terse: Hazelspan Playwright timeout at Pay on windows-latest. Fix locator.
